facts.text: The user requested that the target language be English.
The user requested a 2000-word contrarian article titled "Limiting nitrogen fertilizer will limit agricultural carbon capture and drive co2 levels higher".
The user requested a contrarian style headline that would go viral on social media.
The user requested an introduction followed by 6 body paragraphs.
The user requested each body paragraph to be 300 words long.
The user requested each body paragraph to start with a subheading relevant to the main theme.
The user requested each body paragraph to use 120 words for a specific evidence or argument and then 180 words to address and refute counterarguments.
The user requested a conclusion that summarizes the main arguments and reiterates the importance of the contrarian viewpoint.
The user requested the article to be well-reasoned and supported by evidence.
The user requested the article to include long explanations and use stories, metaphors, and anecdotes.
